description:
Data Engineer-DBA 
 Req number: 
R8807 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Hybrid 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
As a Data Engineer-DBA, you will design the HR data model, lead legacy data conversion, and reconcile person and employee records for our client's HR modernization initiates. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Data Engineer - DBA to design the HR data model, lead legacy data conversion, and reconcile person and employee records with our client for key initiatives, including the agency's HR Modernization initiative. This position will be full-time contract and hybrid (3 days onsite) in Trenton, NJ.
 Only candidates with work authorization that does not require sponsorship now or in the future will be considered. Local candidates only, please. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Design and maintain the PostgreSQL schema for the HR data model
 Manage schema changes through migration tooling such as Flyway or Liquibase with version control
 Partner with developers and architects on data access patterns and performance
 Extract data from Oracle sources and design repeatable conversion and load processes
 Run conversion cycles, validate results, and resolve data quality issues with business owners
 Reconcile person and employee records between the existing system and the new platform
 Build drift detection between two systems that hold the same records with exception reporting and resolution workflows
 Implement data masking for non-production environments to protect sensitive information
 Support database performance tuning, backup and recovery, and access management
 What You’ll Need 
 Required:
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
 7+ years of experience in data engineering or database administration
 PostgreSQL schema design and migration tooling
 Experience extracting data from Oracle sources
 Experience with reconciliation and drift detection between two systems holding the same records
 Experience with data masking for non-production use
 Advanced SQL skills and experience with a scripting language such as Python
 Preferred:
 Ability to read Oracle PL/SQL
 Experience with change data capture tooling
 AWS database certification or experience with Amazon Aurora
 Experience with HR or personnel data
 Experience within Human Services or Child Welfare programs
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
 #LI-NA1

 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.
